I'm here to help you find the right under-eye care for your skin. To get started, I'll ask about your skin tone. Are you ready?

At EyeCojic we focus on care for dark circles and under-eye concerns. Eyecojic comes from a legacy of eye care that dates back to 1973, and the formula was developed through research with specialists and scientists who work on eye issues. Please click on the link to know more: /about

Eyecojic comes from a legacy of eye care that dates back to 1973. RLS is a trusted name in ophthalmic care in India, started in 1973, with a pan-India presence, more than 250 employees, a head office in Prayagraj and a corporate office in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The Eyecojic formula was developed through research with specialists and scientists who work on eye issues.

Eyecojic Under Eye Gel is a light, cooling gel formulated with 2% Kojic Acid and Vitamin E. It is made to reduce the appearance of dark circles, brighten the under-eye area and nourish the delicate skin around the eyes. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without a sticky residue.

The gel contains 2% Kojic Acid and Vitamin E. Kojic Acid is described on our site as a targeted ingredient that helps fade the look of dark under-eye circles. Vitamin E is an antioxidant that helps protect the delicate skin around the eyes. The formula is paraben-free, vegan and cruelty-free.

Dot a pea-sized amount onto your ring finger. Gently tap it around the under-eye area from the inner corner to the outer corner, then let it absorb completely. Use it in the morning and evening on clean skin.
Most customers notice a visible difference within 2 to 4 weeks of consistent daily use, using it morning and night as part of a regular routine. Individual results vary.
The gel is dermatologically tested and designed to be gentle enough for daily use around the delicate eye area. It is paraben-free, vegan and cruelty-free.
Yes. The gel absorbs quickly and leaves no sticky residue, so it works as a base before concealer or other makeup.
Eyecojic Under Eye Gel comes in a 15 g pack. The price shown on the product page is Rs. 349. Prices can change, so the product page is the source of truth at checkout.

Orders placed on the website are usually dispatched within 2 to 3 business days of order confirmation. Standard shipping within India typically takes 5 to 7 business days. Delivery times are estimates and can be delayed by courier issues, holidays or other causes. Shipping charges, if any, are shown at checkout before you confirm. Free shipping is offered above a certain order value that may change from time to time and is shown on the website.

Eligible products can be returned within 7 days of delivery. The product must be unused, unopened and in its original packaging, and you need proof of purchase such as the order confirmation or invoice. For orders placed on the website, email info@eyecojic.com with your order details and the reason for return. After the returned product is received and inspected, the refund goes to the original payment method within 7 to 10 business days. Return shipping is paid by the customer unless the return is due to the company's error or a defective product. Orders bought on Amazon, Flipkart or Myntra must be returned through that marketplace's own return policy.
